acquisition_rules: Acquire raw historical candles read-only; never place or modify an order.
Persist exact raw snapshot bytes outside the governed source tree before deriving research artifacts.
Compute SHA-256 and immutable snapshot identity before strategy evaluation.
Verify bid and ask are present; midpoint-only data cannot satisfy execution-grade reconstruction.
Verify complete M5 candles, strict UTC ordering, uniqueness and expected cadence.
Partition development, validation and reserved final test before strategy metrics are produced.
Do not compute M005 signals or performance metrics on the reserved final-test interval before a separate human authorization.
next_gate: All four required snapshots must be AVAILABLE and individually validated before fixed-M005 reconstruction can move from BLOCKED_DATA_NOT_BOUND.
